implementationBehaviorAssessment: No present state reset or poison mechanism found; prior successful NS read already sets immutableObjectsPreloaded permanently true, and custom-read personal-row negatives reject before default Git dispatch. Removing repeat setup calls should not change current negative outputs.
coverageFinding: The unasserted successful NS calls are also implicit no-throw recovery checks after preceding failures, particularly between row groups. Earlier asserted NS read predates those failures; finalverifyCurrentRuntimeContext uses another entry path. Removing both can reduce regression sensitivity to a future failed-reader/result leak.
recommendation: Retain one explicit asserted default NS read after failures, and assert each negative callback actually observed its intended personal path; or preserve the inter-group recovery call and remove only demonstrably duplicate first warmup.
